scope: Existing 2129 source IDs only; source quality, not artwork-token inference. Inven database observation, not independent NC verification.

added_local_recipe.reason: Newly corrected rare item must retain the existing every-rare-plus-item crafting policy. Matches existing local rare dagger recipe inputs/cost; not a source-game recipe.

save_grade_migration.identity_policy: Exact source ID + name + slot, or verified legacy gameplay name + slot; unknown/wrong IDs do not fall back by name.
save_grade_migration.preserved: All non-grade metadata, including physical and ground IDs, quantities, stats, enhancement, element, blessing, map, position, creation/expiry time and ownership.
